question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
WITH cities AS (
    SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
customers_in_cities AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id 
    FROM customer c
    JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM cities)
),
rentals_in_cities AS (
    SELECT r.inventory_id,
           CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS rental_hours
    FROM rental r
    WHERE r.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers_in_cities)
),
category_hours AS (
    SELECT cat.name AS category_name, SUM(rc.rental_hours) AS total_rental_hours
    FROM rentals_in_cities rc
    JOIN inventory i ON rc.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
    GROUP BY cat.name
    ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM category_hours
